verdict.rationale: Bolna documents only generic API key creation from the dashboard, with no mention of per-key scopes, permissions, restricted access, or least-privilege credentials for an agent. Generating an unscoped account key is an adjacent capability, not the scoped-credential capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Click the Create a new API Key button to generate your unique authentication credentials.
